ارتكموا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَمُوا (irtakamū) /ir.ta.ka.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
# اِرْتَكِمُوا (irtakimū) /ir.ta.ki.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَكَمَ (irtakama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
